# Maintained by the CompositeLaminaLibrarian agent. SI twin: UD_lamina_catalog_SI.txt
# (generated from this file by lamina_catalog_to_SI.py; do not edit the SI file by hand).
#
# Columns: ID | Fiber | Polymer system | E1 | E2 | G12 | nu12 | nu23 | G23 | Xc | Xt | Yc | Yt | S12 | t_ply | rho | Source
#   Xc/Xt = longitudinal compressive/tensile strength, Yc/Yt = transverse compressive/tensile strength,
#   S12 = in-plane shear strength. Strengths are positive magnitudes.
#   NA = not reported by the source.  * = estimate, not measured:
#     nu23* : matrix-dominated default (0.45 carbon/epoxy, 0.40 glass & basalt/epoxy, 0.45 flax)
#             or taken from the AS4/PEEK set L026 (0.49) for PEEK/PAEK rows.
#     G23*  : G23 = E2 / (2 (1 + nu23))  (transverse isotropy, same relation as PlyPropertyGenerator).
#     t*    : see per-ID note.
#   Conditions are room temperature dry/ambient, mean (not B-basis) values unless noted.
#   Unit conversions from US units: 1 ksi = 6.894757 MPa, 1 Msi = 6.894757 GPa, 1 in = 25.4 mm.
#

# PLY THICKNESS (project decision; 0.045 mm on 2026-11-04, 0.035 mm since 2026-11-05): t_ply = 0.035 mm for EVERY row, so that all materials can be
#   used for thin-shell deployable structures, assuming they could be made as 35 um plies. Stiffness, strength and
#   density are still those measured at the original thickness. Thin plies usually show higher in-situ transverse and
#   shear strengths and somewhat different Xc, so the strengths here are an approximation for 35 um plies.
#   Original ply thickness in mm (* = estimate, NA = not reported) before the change:
#     L001 0.183, L002 0.131, L003 0.188, L004 0.140, L005 0.145, L006 0.140, L007 0.140, L008 0.152
#     L009 0.194*, L010 0.191, L011 0.183, L012 0.201, L013 NA, L014 NA, L015 NA, L016 NA
#     L017 NA, L018 NA, L019 NA, L020 NA, L021 0.030, L022 0.030, L023 0.030, L024 0.08
#     L025 0.127, L026 0.14, L027 0.125, L028 0.076, L029 0.14, L030 0.135, L031 0.137, L032 0.183
#     L033 0.21, L034 1.19, L035 0.42, L036 0.18*, L037 0.213*
#
# ASSUMED VALUES that replace NA (2026-11-04, marked *; not measured for that material):
#  nu12: L010, L012 0.317* (T800S/F3900 measured, L009); L011 0.32* (mean of the measured carbon/epoxy rows L001-L009);
#        L029-L033 0.32* (AS4/PEEK L025/L026; typical carbon/thermoplastic).
#  L025 G12 6.0* (same APC-2 material, L026; Sun & Yoon 45-deg back-calculation gives 6.4-7.1).
#  L023 strengths from T800S/3900 (L010): Xt, Xc scaled by E1 ratio 127.9/148 (fiber-dominated, Vf 50% vs ~57%);
#        Yc, Yt, S12 copied (matrix-dominated, toughened aerospace epoxy).
#  L027 Yc 176*, S12 82.6* from AS4/PEEK L026.   L029 Yc 176* from AS4/PEEK L026.
#  L030 Yc 192* from AS4/LM-PAEK L031 (same polymer family).   L031, L032 Yt 90* from T1100GC/LM-PAEK L030 (TC1225).
#  L033 Yc 156* = 4 Yt (Yc/Yt of the catalog's carbon/polymer rows is ~2-4.5; no carbon/PPS Yc found).
#  L037 (flax) Xc 143* = 0.45 Xt (Xc/Xt of UD flax/epoxy is ~0.4-0.5); Yc 78* = 3 Yt;
#        S12 39.5* = sigma(+-45 UTS 79 MPa, Liang 2014) / 2, the ASTM D3518 relation.
#
# L038 M30SC/PEEK (Benazzo & Pellegrino, AIAA SciTech 2025, Table 1; no DOI found): 4-ply UD laminates, autoclave
#   (365 C, 5.5 bar), Sakai Ovex prepreg 68 gsm (38 gsm CF + 30 gsm PEEK), Vf 0.49 (micro-CT), measured ply thickness
#   0.055 mm (set to 0.035 like all rows). E1, nu12 from UD tension (DIC); G12, S12 from +-45 tension (S12 at the
#   change of slope = yield); Xt, Xc, Yt, Yc are YIELD strengths from parallel-platen bending with DIC curvature, not
#   ultimate strengths; Yc < Yt as measured. nu23* 0.49 from AS4/PEEK L026, G23* from the relation.
#   rho* = 0.49 x 1.73 (M30SC, Toray TORAYCA yarn TDS; read from a scrambled PDF table, check) + 0.51 x 1.30 (PEEK, L029 PDS).
#   https://media.easycomposites.co.uk/datasheets/Toray%20Fibre%20TDS.pdf
#
# Usability (see check output of lamina_catalog_to_SI.py):
#   PlyPropertyGenerator needs E1, E2, G12, nu12 (+ nu23).  In-plane Tsai-Hill needs Xt, Xc, Yt, Yc, S12.
#   All 38 rows have every column since 2026-11-04 (some through * assumptions, see above).
#   G23 not equal to E2/(2(1+nu23)) as given by the source: L009, L016 (small), L022 (suspect), L034.
#   L038: Yc < Yt as measured (yield strengths), so the script warns "Yc <= Yt"; expected.
#
